faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras) for an ICMR-sponsored research project based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under this notification?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Project Scientist-I (Non-Medical) under temporary engagement.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Scientist-I (Non-Medical) position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist-I position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 56,000/- plus 30% HRA, totaling Rs. 72,800/- per month including HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a first-class PG degree (including integrated PG) or PhD, or a second-class PG degree (including integrated PG) with a PhD degree.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is up to 35 years as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the online application form is 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official careers portal of IIT Madras at https://icandsr.iitm.ac.in/careers/current_openings.php.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIT Madras Project Scientist-I?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting based on online applications followed by a test or interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee details are mentioned in the official notification for submitting the online application form.
